Principal Responsibilities
Handle all Int’l main trade finance transactions for DBS clients including import/export L/Cs, Bank Guarantee etc.
处理星展银行客户的所有国际贸易融资业务包括进出口信用证，银行保函等业务。
Back up handle all trade finance transactions for DBS clients including OA Finance and Draft transactions.
候补处理星展银行客户的所有应收应付账款融资业务和票据融资业务。
Support bank’s project management of the trade service product processing optimization, especially AI projects UR analysis, design, testing & launch
支持银行贸易服务产品及流程及系统优化项目，重点支持AI项目相关的需求分析、设计测试，上线等环节。
Check supporting docs according to bank’s guidance/trade finance procedure and ensure applications compliance with internal control requirement as well as compliance requirement.
根据银行的操作指引以及贸易融资的操作流程审核相关证明文件，以确保交易申请符合银行内控和合规要求。
Checking trade finance documents according to UCP/URDG/ISBP/URR and other international trade finance practice.
根据相关国际惯例审核贸易融资单据。
Booking trade finance and relevant funds disbursement in banking system and make data information verification. Process cash margin, BAD/CAD pledge on transactional basis.
将相关贸易融资以及资金的转移收付录入银行系统并确保数据准确性, 根据流程处理交易层面的客户保证金和质押票据的收付。
Conduct post checking/monitoring of trade related supporting documents which shall be align with “3 measures & 1 guideline”.
根据”3个办法一个指引” 的要求进行贷后文件的跟踪和审核。
Handle DBS client inquiry on trade finance related transactions.
处理星展客户关于贸易融资业务的查询/咨询。
Make sure any deviations/irregulars were raised to Team head, and obtain proper DOA approval on exceptions.
确保任何异常交易被上报给部门主管，并且在处理异例前得到相应的授权。
Conduct regulatory, MIS and other internal/external reporting for trade finance business i.e.SAFE/UPRR/RCPMIS/FTZMIS etc.
及时提交对内对外相关报表。
Assist team head to improve/maintain internal and external audit score, and make sure no significant finding during assessment.
协助部门主管/经理共同达到集团内部审计和外部审计的评定要求，并在规定时间内完成整改要求。
Participate in bank’s training if necessary.
积极参与银行相关培训。
Education And Relevant Experience
Bachelor degree holder or above. 本科学历或以上。
Minimum 3 years’ experience in Trade Finance operations including import/export trade finance, OA Finance and Draft etc. 3年以上银行贸易融资国际结算操作部门经验, 包括进出口贸易融资结算业务、应收/应付融资业务、票据融资业务等。
CDCS certificate/CSDG certificate 信用证单证专家证书（国际商会）或者保函备用证专家证书(国际商会)。
Good knowledge on trade finance related products, rules and regulations, International practice 熟识贸易融资业务和产品，以及相关规则, 国际惯例等。
Basic knowledge of accounting 熟悉会计基础知识。
Proficient in commonly used data analysis software e.g., Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, R, Python, etc. 熟悉常用的数据分析软件，例如：Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, R, Python 等。
Good data visualization skills: Ability to create clear, concise, and insightful charts and reports 具备良好的数据可视化能力，能够创建清晰易懂的图表和报告。
Good PC skills and good command of English and Mandarin. 熟练的电脑操作能力, 精通英语和普通话。
Good communication skill and problem solving skill. 良好的沟通技巧和解决问题的能力。

CIB COO (Corporate and Institutional Banking)
Our COO team delivers strategic execution for Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) across the globe. Through transformative data and digital solutions, customer servicing, and non-financial risk expertise, this team is where problems are solved, and careers are made.
CIB COO Focuses On These Key Priorities
Protecting the bank, our customers and stakeholders by enhancing our operational resilience, strengthen our control environment, and improve risk management.
Driving operational excellence and efficiency by optimising our processes and delivering the transition to net zero in our own operations.
Enabling business growth exceptional service by enabling our businesses to focus on our competitive advantage and deliver transformation and digitisation across the bank.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Collect relevant information from various sources to assist the Relationship Managers with facilities related to credit proposals and operational matters
Check covenant compliance certificate and covenant fulfilment
Support Security Control co-ordination
Check facility letters prepared by Credit Ops or Relationship Managers, ensure the return of acknowledged copies of such letters prior to the expiry date therein and take prompt follow-up action on outstanding items
Check customer and facility related documents and take prompt follow-up action on outstanding items. To arrange renewal of security documents
Facilitate the loan drawdown process through close liaison with Client Management and Credit Ops on account opening, and ensure that security requirements have been completed before facilityc limits are loaded
Work closely with CLM and relationship managers in the team and support them to complete all KYC process in a timely manner.
Execute or support the approval of low/medium risk periodic review profile
Reconcile the data in OMNIA and the baseline in DCP report
Deal independently with e-mail or telephone enquiries from customers and liaise closely with other HSBC departments and branches in answering / resolving customer queries / issues. Proactively follow-up on outstanding matters
Undertake all required activities as directed by line manager or as agreed in annual objectives in support of the development of the Banking business
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Solid understanding of Banking operations and its products / services, general knowledge of trade, treasury, and payment and cash management products and activities
Relevant work experience supporting Relationship Managers or Sales teams in a financial institution (bank or non-bank)
Relevant credit application and credit monitoring experience is a plus
Excellent client servicing skills (minimum 2 years of service in a client facing role)
Results focused and an ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-moving environment
Ability to work independently but also as a team player, with highly developed interpersonal skills
Ability to prioritize competing demands
Ability to understand and consolidate diverse and complex business information and identify and mitigate risk issues
Be change oriented and explore ways of enhanced working and have a forward-thinking mind-set, in line with the Group's values and strategy
Excellent analysis and problem-solving skills
Proficient in AI tools
Fluent verbal and written English
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

Job Description
Job Summary
Manage the Product control function for China across Business
Provide strong oversight of the integrity, accuracy and timely reporting of China trading revenues, balance sheet positions and valuation adjustments, ensuring that financial results are appropriately controlled and understood.
Establish and maintain a China-specific Product Control and Valuation Control framework that meets local regulatory requirements while remaining aligned with the bank’s global policies, standards and risk appetite.
Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance and Operations to support sustainable business growth by providing independent challenge, identifying emerging financial and valuation risks, and enabling informed commercial decision-making.
Strengthen the local control environment through effective governance, clear ownership, high-quality management information and the development of capable China-based Product Control and Valuation Control resources.
Manage the Valuation Control deliverables as applicable for China regulatory requirements
Key Responsibilities
Lead a China-based Product Control and Valuation Control team, while also acting as a hands-on subject matter expert. The role combines people leadership with significant individual contribution, particularly in resolving complex control, valuation, accounting and regulatory matters.
Oversee the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of daily and monthly P&L, balance sheet substantiation, valuation adjustments, independent price verification and other core Product Control and Valuation Control activities for the China business.
Establish and maintain an effective China-specific control framework that meets local regulatory expectations and is aligned with the bank’s global Product Control and Valuation Control policies, methodologies and governance standards.
Coordinate extensively with global and regional Product Control and Valuation Control teams to obtain technical input, clarify policy requirements, resolve methodology differences and ensure consistent application of global standards within the China business.
Provide independent review and challenge of trading results, valuation methodologies, reserves, model inputs, adjustments and balance sheet positions. Ensure material issues are identified, investigated, escalated and resolved within agreed timelines.
Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations, Treasury, Compliance and Technology to support new products, business growth and regulatory initiatives, ensuring that appropriate financial controls and valuation processes are in place before implementation.
Support the China business by providing clear analysis of revenue performance, valuation uncertainty, balance sheet risks, control weaknesses and emerging issues, enabling informed management and commercial decision-making.
Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
Allocate work, set priorities, review outputs and develop the capability of the local team. Ensure clear accountability, appropriate segregation of duties, adequate documentation and effective backup arrangements.
Drive improvements in processes, reporting, data quality and automation, reducing manual adjustments and recurring breaks while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.
Maintain effective governance over material issues, exceptions and control breaches, with clear ownership, action plans, escalation thresholds and reporting to relevant China, regional and global committees.
The role holder is accountable for both the day-to-day effectiveness of the local Product Control and Valuation Control function and the successful coordination of China requirements with the wider global control organisation.
People and Talent
Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
Lead by example by role-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.
Motivations
Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, where local requirements may differ from global standards and require careful interpretation, escalation and practical implementation.
Resolving valuation, P&L and balance sheet issues involving incomplete data, methodology differences, manual processes or unclear ownership across local, regional and global teams.
Building a credible and sustainable local Product Control and Valuation Control framework while working with limited resources, competing priorities and significant dependency on global subject-matter experts.
Managing periods of heightened regulatory, audit or senior-management scrutiny, requiring timely responses, clear evidence of control effectiveness and disciplined delivery of remediation commitments.
Challenging senior business and functional stakeholders on valuation assumptions, manual adjustments, control weaknesses and financial risks, while maintaining constructive relationships and supporting business objectives.
Driving long-term process and control improvements where solutions require coordination across multiple teams, changes to systems or data, and sustained follow-through rather than short-term fixes.
Developing and retaining a small local team capable of handling complex issues independently, while maintaining delivery quality during periods of change, pressure or increased business activity.
Skills and Experience
Must-have Skills
Product Control and Valuation Control understanding
Financial Markets and Trading Products
China Regulatory awareness
Other Skills
Control Framework and risk management
Stakeholder Management
Analytical and Communication skills
Valuation knowledge – IPV/FVA/PVA
Qualifications
Key Experiences
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
Proven Experience leading complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure
Certifications/Qualifications
CICPA & CFA is preferred
Languages
Chinese and English

They have delegated authority and empowerment to prioritize the product backlog to maximize the value of our products or services for both our customers and our business. Their core ethos is to make informed decisions to ensure each investment decision results in the maximum (as measured by OKRs) outcome balancing both short-medium- and long-term horizons. The Product Owner is responsible for maximizing the value of digital products and ensuring that digital journeys meet global standards for consistency, scalability, and customer outcomes. The Mobile Capability Lead is a strategic and technical leader responsible for driving mobile development excellence across the organization. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with leadership in capability building, stakeholder engagement, and organizational alignment.

Product Leadership, Engagement & Strategy
Product Discovery & Experimentation

Technical Capabilities & Excellence

Job Summary
The role holder will spearhead the stressed and distressed loan trading strategy of the Loan Trading, East desk within Credit Trading. This person will be responsible for making sure that proper risk analyses are done prior to risk proposals, and that relevant risk approvals are in place. Therefore, the role holder will need to be highly experienced and skilled/proven across all aspects of stressed and distressed loan trading to be convincingly effective in conveying clear, accurate ideas and the correct risk picture in securing relevant approvals and limits. In summary, the role holder will diligently manage a risk book designed to book stressed / distressed loans and secondarily trade par loans opportunistically with profitable churn within ageing limits.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy
To grow meaningfully the secondary trading franchise of fixed income assets – IG, HY & Financials of issuers in Greater China (“China Credit”) for Global Credit Trading.
Work with Sales, e-Sales, e-Trading, Research, Capital Markets, Technology and Syndication to execute initiatives to grow the broader Global Credit franchise.
Awareness and understanding of the strategy and business model of the larger Trading Group and Global Credit, as appropriate to the role.
Ensuring effective end to end client identification, risk management, service and infrastructure.
Work in conjunction with other partners to ensure SCB has a best-in-class offering for the EM credit asset class especially China Local Currency Credit.
Assistant in sending market colour / comments to sales on daily basis and promoting China onshore flow business.
Providing timely updated credit analysis/ profiles on China credit names for trading desk and to sales
Facilitate smooth deal execution including deal detail check and help to centralize booking instruction when necessary.
Helping sales translate specific clients’ needs into specific bonds.
Deliver training and education on products to internal and external audiences (sales and clients)
Ensure the stability, long-term sustainability, and reputation of the Bank.
Identifying areas of concern on matters of appropriateness/suitability and raising them to senior team members.
Provide timely support on credit bonds both at the trade idea origination level and at execution time
Generate/providing market watch and generic trade ideas to sales force, provide support on documentation review and drafting, deliver marketing support and product explanation to sales and to clients when necessary.
Analysing, assessing and propose specific credit bonds based on specific client needs, liaise with sales/trading/legal/MO and other related support functions to transform idea to trade.
Business
Increase SCB’s visibility by driving commercial, competitive pricing of credit trading for our clients.
Help manage the implementation of flow credit trading specific strategies and ensure that performance objectives and revenue goals are met and RWA targets managed.
Active performance monitoring – spot areas of underperformance and take corrective action.
Processes
Ensure adherence to all internal and external regulations.
To embed Operational Risk monitoring as an integral part of the business process. Towards this, to effectively carry out the assigned role, if any, under Compliance Risk Management and Operational Risk Management Assurance.
Ensure that the business meets its obligations the prevention of money laundering under the Group Policy and Standards and under local laws and regulations.
Help ensure that there are appropriate and documented internal controls and procedures in place. Help monitor the operation of such procedures and controls and regularly review them to ensure that they reflect any changes in products, systems, policy and regulations.
People & Talent
Build a transparent and collaborative culture in which incentives are based on support of Client Income with specific performance metrics on the Bank’s values.
To work in partnership with Credit Flow teams across to ensure that the flow trading product is value additive for clients and the bank.
Risk Management
Identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group. Also, an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them.
Embed operational risk management and reporting as an integral part of the business process.
Ensure that adequate and appropriate systems and controls are in place to comply with Group and Business policies, procedures, standards, and codes.
Monitor all major risk issues and concentrations. Where appropriate, direct remedial action and/or ensure adequate reporting to Risk Committees.
Comply with guidelines as outlined in the annual Trader Mandate.
Governance
Promote an environment where compliance with internal control functions and external regulatory framework is a central priority of the business.
Establish, maintain, and supervise the framework to ensure business functions under my area of responsibility comply with internal policies, procedures, codes and applicable external laws and regulations and adhere to the expected high standards set out in the FM Code of Conduct.
Ensure the overall targets relating to budget are cascaded to teams with appropriate product targets and performance delivery on targets is proactively managed.
Regulatory & Business Conduct
Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
Achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment.
Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate, and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
Adhere to any applicable regulators prescribed responsibilities.
Key stakeholders
Internal
Credit Flow Sales, e-Sales
Credit Research, Syndication, Capital Markets
Credit Solutions and other teams in Credit Trading
Support and Control functions
Modelling and Analytics Group
External
As and when necessary
Other Responsibilities
Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in CIB Markets; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.
Skills And Experience
In-depth knowledge of the distressed credit landscape in APAC, covering illiquid, stressed/distressed debt, and special situations
Trading & analysis experience across a wide spectrum of loans: in varying credit rating qualities, structures, tenor, jurisdictions, and industries over many years
Track record of risk managing loan assets, including stressed/distressed, and distributing risk
Sharp business acumen, including ability to assess risk and commensurate level of RoRWA / RoTE
Qualifications
A bachelor’s or master’s degree in top universities in related majors
Strong interest in credit trading/sales business
Strong mathematical and numerical skills
Proficiency in data collection and analysis
Excellent research and writing abilities
Thorough understanding of credit market and financial analysis
Interpersonal skills and the ability to work under pressure
A team player who can work independently
[CFETS] Interbank Market CNY Product Trading License
[CFTC & National Futures Association & SEC] Authorized Associated Person Registration - SEC AAP registered.
[SEC] 15a-6 registered.

对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；

学习并了解一切相关条例以及内部风险与合规的政策与程序；
保持对金融行业相关动向的敏感；
积极参与银行组织的培训项目，会议和简报会，并保证将学习到的技能和知识运用到日常工作中；
确保客户投诉的时效与管理；

Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.
Business
Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates
Processes
Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.

Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures

Governance
Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Financial skills
Analytical skills
Qualifications
Selection Criteria:
Full time Bachelor’s degree, or AMAC Fund Qualification Certificate Holder.
1 year or above working experience in financial industry, acting in good faith and professional ethics. Have a good command of knowledge about wealth management sales activities related regulations
Sound knowledge of financial products and services and banking procedures, equities markets, unit trusts and other personal investment services are preferred.
Good investment counseling and analytical skills.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, ability to deal with all levels of people, often in complex and difficult situations.
Team player who shows initiative and assertiveness.
Self-motivator who is keen to upgrade, improve personal knowledge and skills to meet job requirements.
Good command of both spoken and written English and Mandarin

全日制大学本科学历，或持有基金从业资格证书。

熟悉理财业务活动及理财产品销售相关的法律法规

具备良好的投资咨询和分析技巧。
出色的人际关系能力和沟通能力，能在复杂场合应付自如。
具有团队意识，主动坚定。
有上进心，能自我激励，不断提高人际交流能力和技巧，以满足工作要求。

Key Responsibilities
As a Product Owner in our cross-functional squads, the candidate will drive the outcomes of the squad to deliver on their objectives and key results. You will build and prioritise the product backlog to achieve business goals and manage stakeholder relationships to align expectation, prioritisation and overall product roadmap.
Strategy
The primary purpose of this position is to develop and transform Capital Markets Products & Solutions (CMPS) product capability to provide digital channels for both clients and internal users across Private Banking and Retail Banking.
The Bank is aiming to grow product capability through digital and self-direct channels. This Product Owner (PO) role is to drive the agile technology projects to establish a robust price discovery and execution platform. It is also required to build system interface with upstream systems (e.g. client information check) and downstream systems (e.g. booking trades into core banking platforms) to streamline operation flow and improve users (including clients) experience and frontline productivity.
As PO, you will develop and maintain a vision for agile technology projects and be responsible for communicating the vision to the scrum team. Be responsible for agile technology projects and features from concept to final implementation. In particular,
Have a good understanding of wealth management products, it's processes and relevance to clients.
Define and own the strategic digital product vision and roadmap for the wealth management product suite.
Align product strategy with business goals, market trends, and client needs.
Develop a competitive product strategy across relevant asset classes (such as FX, equities, fixed income, structured products, OTC derivatives, funds, and insurance.)
Monitor market dynamics and regulatory changes, ensuring products remain competitive and compliant.
As PO you will work with architects, business stakeholders and development teams to ensure that business, quality and functional goals are met with each release. Be responsible for the design, usability, quality and delivery of agile technology projects and features.
As the subject matter expert, this role is to determine business requirements, review technology project plans from the business perspective, and ensure new technology capabilities are embedded in business processes to deliver benefits. Ensure smooth execution on the ground, and communicate the changes delivered to relevant stakeholders including front office.
Business
Review and understand key business policies and processes in Wealth Management in offering CMPS products and services to both private banking and retail banking clients. Identify critical pain-points and articulate how planned / in-flight technology projects will solve them.
As Product Owner (PO), specialized in Digital platforms, should be familiar with the development of CMPS order management/ execution platforms and ensure that it is properly interfaced with multiple downstream booking systems.
The PO should have strong technical knowhow to improve front office systems performance and expand product penetration according to the business development.
Processes
The PO is the key decision maker on priorities and design decisions, and work to ensure that all stakeholders are aligned at each stage of the agile development lifecycle (when a new project is created). The PO also needs to understand both the engineering and business side of releases and be ultimately responsible for representing the end user’s needs.
Provide business input on requirements to the technology project teams. Work with subject-matter experts in product teams, front office and operations on requirements (e.g., a new electronic workflow to simplify layers of checking, or to auto-populate repeated fields in client forms). Prioritise “must have” items vs. “good to have”.
Review technology plans and design specifications, to ensure business requirements are met and that benefits will be delivered. Identify impact on critical processes within the Bank’s operational risk framework and work with process owners and project teams to ensure robust controls.
Work with technology project teams to develop test plans. Co-ordinate business users to test new platforms or technology features that are developed. Ensure final delivery meets user needs.
Work with stakeholders in the front, middle and back offices to ensure successful “go live” of projects, from the business perspective. Develop training material, co-ordinate briefings, design and execute communication plans. Gather feedback post-implementation, and track benefits captured.
Participate in project review meetings and identify/highlight any potential issue that may impact project’s cost, timeline and/or scope and work with concerned stakeholders for its early resolution to bring back the project on track.
Conduct periodic briefings to senior management on progress of technology projects, from the business perspective. Highlight issues that require resolution.
People & Talent
Work towards strengthening the performance culture and reinforcement of accountabilities in products. Sharing the technical skills and experience with other team members.
Risk Management
Embed a risk culture that supports the Bank’s strategy and philosophy for the management of risk.
Ensure that effective arrangements are in place within WM in the region for the prevention of money laundering in line with the Group Policy and Standards, respective country regulatory guidelines and local legal requirements. In particular, ensure that the obligations on reporting suspicious activities are met.
Ensure that Risk Management matters that are brought to the job holder’s attention are subject to direct remedial action and/or ensure adequate reporting to the relevant Risk Committees
Governance
At all times have an awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
Regulatory & Business Conduct
Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
Lead the business to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles
Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
Key stakeholders
Regional and Country Wealth Management Heads and WM Product Managers.
Key markets Segment Heads, IAs and RMs
Market/Credit/Operational Risk, Legal, Compliance, Middle Office and COO team
Other Responsibilities
Perform other responsibilities assigned by Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
To achieve other business and non-financial objectives
To drive the Bank’s strategy and franchise development
To ensure that the business is conducted in an operationally robust environment
To ensure compliance with regulations and controls as set by the Bank and external regulatory authorities
Skills And Experience
Strong risk evaluation experience in Capital Markets / Wealth Management products
An ideal candidate should have 5 years of experience in technology & business
Extensive knowledge in financial market products
Qualifications
Education: Relevant degree from reputable university
Training: Project Management / System Development or equivalent mandatory & developmental – role specific and regulatory/compliance bank wide specific
Language: Proficient English
Minimum of 5-8 years of experience in wealth management, investment banking, or financial services.
Good understanding of wealth management products and asset classes (example FX, equities, fixed income, structured products, OTC derivatives, funds, and insurance.)
Relevant knowledge of regulatory and operational frameworks in wealth management.
Preferred: Understanding of global wealth management market trends.
